scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background
engineering_observations: All ten retained full-frame tiles were inspected. Gold direct amodal rectangles and labels appear on positives, with no corresponding central boxed form or gold label in the absent row.

The positive 0.5 cm/px tile shows a large dark tapered diagonal silhouette with nose upper-left and tail/flukes lower-right. The corresponding form becomes smaller and loses fine body detail at coarser GSD; at 4 cm/px the very tiny form and gold border dominate.

The absent 0.5 cm/px tile looks apparently uniform blue at contact-sheet scale. At 1 cm/px a partial background animal remains at the lower edge; at 2/3/4 cm/px many unlabelled background animals remain. All views were retained and reviewed; none were dropped.
Some paired background animals differ in shading and shape detail, especially at coarser GSD. The cause is unestablished, and bitwise or photometric background identity is not claimed.

This test-split shallow_swim snapshot retains actual GAMA root depth 0.5m and the static upright proxy. Direct amodal boxes do not establish an exact visible/refracted outline. Machine rendered_visibility remains unknown and biological approval remains false.
